description.value:
You have a pool of deathly energy represented by a number of points equal to twice your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier.

When you roll damage for a necromancy spell or an undead you control, you can deal additional necrotic damage by spending points from the pool, up to its current maximum.

When a creature of at least CR 1/8 dies within 60 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to harvest part of its remaining life force, regaining a number of points equal to the creature's CR (minimum of 1). You cannot do so if the creature is an undead or construct.

You regain expended points equal to your Proficiency when you finish a Short Rest and all expended points when you finish a Long Rest.
